15.title: Stage 15 arm A: the somatic sodium equations swapped human for rodent on the human cell, dosed for the characteristic curve of the rise at 310 pA
15.prediction: The spike-1 rise through the stage-12 chain falls monotonically with the inserted human NaTg density, giving the characteristic curve; if the equation lineage is the rise's remaining input, some dose in 0.068 to 0.544 S/cm2 puts the rise within 15 percent of the recorded 348 V/s while the 310 pA count stays within 5 to 15 (recorded 10) and the spike-1 take-off stays in the recorded band. The dose at which the curve crosses 348 is reported by interpolation and flagged inside or outside the series. Reported, not banded: fall, peak, threshold, the first-interval threshold step and the rise ratio spike 5 over spike 1. Amended bracket: at B3's own somatic conductance 2.641 S/cm2 the equations alone are swapped, and the curve is read across 1.320 / 2.641 / 5.282 together with the four retained lower doses.
15.rejection: No dose brings the rise within 15 percent of 348 (the equation lineage is not the remaining input; the residual belongs elsewhere and is reported, not repaired); or every dose that does also leaves the count band (the rise is bought with the count); or the rise does not move monotonically with the dose (the dose is not acting through the somatic sodium).
15.unchanged: The human anatomy of Allen 541563728 and every non-somatic-sodium density of the B3 fit; the recorded command plus the recorded bias; sweep 53 only; nseg factor 9; CVode 1e-10; 34 degrees; stop 2100 ms; the recording, its chain and the readers. Only the somatic sodium equations change: rodent NaTs zeroed, human NaTg inserted with HL23PYR's voltage shifts.

amendment: Recorded 2026-09-13 after the first four runs, before the second bracket. The first series (0.068 / 0.136 / 0.272 / 0.544 S/cm2) was bracketed on HL23PYR's own somatic NaTg value 0.272, which does not transfer to this cell: at 0.068 and 0.136 the cell is silent at 310 pA (no spike, rest -84.5 mV), because B3's soma carries 2.641 S/cm2 of sodium and the human NaTg's +13 mV activation shift needs at least as much. The corrected bracket holds B3's OWN somatic sodium conductance and changes only the equations, which is the cleaner isolation the split wanted: 1.320 (0.5x), 2.641 (1x, the matched-density equation swap) and 5.282 (2x). The silent runs are retained and reported as the low end of the characteristic curve, not discarded.
